cards.name: Ursarctic Hextanius

effects.printed_clause: Cannot be Synchro Summoned; must be Special Summoned by sending two controlled Ursarctic monsters with Level difference 6.
effects.lua_implementation: The custom Extra Deck procedure checks face-up Ursarctic materials, exact difference, sendability and Extra Zone, then sends both.

official_references.matched_structure: Ursarctic Polari is the exact official structural family for Level-difference procedures.

effects.printed_clause: For the Special Summon of any Ursarctic Synchro, this card can be Level 7 or 8 and a non-Tuner.
effects.lua_implementation: The alternate Level/non-Tuner values are consumed by the three CCG Ursarctic procedures that explicitly call Hextanius-aware helpers; the card cannot inject those choices into unrelated official Extra Deck procedures.

official_references.matched_structure: Ursarctic Polari is an official Ursarctic procedure that would need to recognize the substitution but contains no Hextanius hook.

effects.issue: Confirmed as an engine/procedure integration gap, not safely patchable in this card alone: official Ursarctic Synchros implement their own EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC and expose no card-local hook through which Hextanius can supply two alternate Levels and a non-Tuner role.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned: Special Summon a WATER monster with 700 ATK or 700 DEF from Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed summon trigger filters WATER and either exact stat, checks zone, and Special Summons one.

official_references.matched_structure: Big Belly Knight demonstrates a summon trigger leading to a filtered Special Summon.

effects.printed_clause: Banish this from GY; shuffle up to 3 other Ursarctic cards from GY/banishment into Deck, then draw 1.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition cost banishes self; operation selects one to three other legal cards, shuffles, then draws only if at least one returned.

official_references.matched_structure: Thunder Dragon Fusion uses shuffle-to-Deck handling across GY/banishment.

effects.printed_clause: Each listed activated effect is once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The two activated effects use id and id+100.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed an unresolved cross-script Ursarctic procedure gap; no unsafe card-local workaround was added.

coverage_override.reason: The audit records split this card into its material/procedure, restrictions, activated or continuous operations, and printed count-limit clauses; no printed functional clause is omitted.
